name: Gyakuten Live!
source:
Gyakuten Live! is a Love Live fangame with Ace Attorney-style gam play. Travel through the adventures of your favorite school idols as you solve mysteries and prove the innocence of your clients. Currently has: 2 episodes, with more on the way!

[From itch.io]
translation:
《Gyakuten Live!》是一款采用《逆转裁判》式玩法的《Love Live!》同人游戏。跟随你喜爱的学园偶像展开冒险，破解谜团，为委托人证明清白。目前包含两个章节，后续章节仍在制作中！

[摘自itch.io]
